title: Separate live policy overrides from legacy workflow-runner route validation
failure_signature: The installed workflow runner rejected the live 100000-word and six-commit caps because it still encodes the older policy shape.
trigger_preconditions: A newer live request expands policy caps beyond the installed workflow runner's encoded values.
candidate_workaround: Preserve the authoritative live request and failed audit, then validate only immediate route structure through a marked compatibility projection that carries the live overrides explicitly.
recurrence_guard: Never present a compatibility projection as validation of the newer policy values.
rollback: Retain the failed audit and stop route execution if the immediate ownership projection also fails.
scope_boundary: The passing projection validates immediate route structure only, not the expanded caps.
